item.title: “A lot to welcome but don’t underestimate inward investment’s impact on regional jobs and growth” British Film Commission response to Culture, Media & Sport Committee report
item.description: Responding to the Culture, Media & Sport Committee’s ‘British film and high-end television’ Report, published today (Thursday, 10 April), Adrian Wootton OBE, Chief Executive of the British Film Commission, said: “There’s a lot to welcome in today’s report, not least the recommendation to increase funding for the UK Global Screen Fund and support for the […] The post “A lot to welcome but don’t underestimate inward investment’s impact on regional jobs and growth” British Film Commission response
